name: Elizabeth Lamoreaux

events.title: Marriage
events.description: To George Palmer Ransom (1762-1850); FS cites HSP marriage and baptism records

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives Elizabeth's birth as 18 Oct 1776 at Monroe, Orange Co., NY, against 30 Sep 1776 on the site, and her marriage to George Palmer Ransom at Plymouth on 9 Jan 1794. It cites Historical Society of Pennsylvania baptism and marriage records and finds her in his household in 1850 (S1).
